title: Postal Address
description: A structured postal address. The postcode field declares x-address-lookup so the form renderer dispatches the postcode lookup control when an address-lookup provider is configured, and falls back to plain text otherwise. Field widths are tuned for the wizard layout: line1/line2 full-width; town/region/postcode share a horizontal row (each third); country sits on its own row as half-width to leave room alongside address-lookup feedback UI.
